ctx.x: Thank you. Boy, there’s something in the water out here.

Wow. You see, you’re starting to have it. Roy Haynes, yeah. That was also a great gig, because Henry Grimes was the bassist. Frank Strozier. So it was great. And playing with Roy was – wow, what an experience. We even had uniforms.
